intro.fr: Oxygen Not Included se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Oxygen Not Included can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Klei Entertainment sort Oxygen Not Included en 2019.
text.en: Klei Entertainment releases Oxygen Not Included in 2019.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub ShadowKitty42/ONI-Archipelago, qui héberge l'APWorld de Oxygen Not Included.
text.en: The GitHub repository ShadowKitty42/ONI-Archipelago, home of the Oxygen Not Included APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, v0.1.
text.en: The first version, v0.1, is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version v0.9.11, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (16 versions publiées).
text.en: Version v0.9.11 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (16 versions released).

text.fr: Comme beaucoup de jeux, Oxygen Not Included rejoint Archipelago par un APWorld non officiel : un fichier .apworld distribué à part, que chaque joueur ajoute lui-même à son installation pour l'intégrer à un multiworld.
text.en: Like many games, Oxygen Not Included joins Archipelago through an unofficial APWorld: a .apworld file distributed separately, which each player adds to their own install to bring it into a multiworld.
